content.description:
At Lenskart, we believe that clear vision is fundamental to the personal development and well-being of an individual, and our aim is to build tech-enabled solutions that improve access to affordable and quality ‘Eyewear for All’. We commenced our operations in India as an online business in 2010 and opened our first retail store in New Delhi in 2013. Since then, we have scaled through both the online and offline channels and have established a presence through our retail stores, websites, mobile applications, and other channels.
Mission Brief: Lead the Transformation of Lenskart's InventoryThis is a high-impact leadership role focused on building and operationalizing a world-class, proprietary Inventory Planning Platform. You will be the architect responsible for transforming how Lenskart manages over $1 billion in inventory, moving us from static planning methods to a real-time, AI-driven decision engine.
Your mission is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and exponential retail growth. You will be defining and delivering the system that ensures we have the right product, in the right place, at the right time, maximizing profitability and customer satisfaction globally.
🔑 Core Mandate: Platform Development & Business Transformation1. Internal Planning Platform Creation (The Builder's Focus)Platform Visionary: Own the strategic vision, architecture, and deployment of Lenskart's proprietary AI/ML-based planning platform (the Inventory Decision Engine). This includes key modules for predictive demand sensing, optimal allocation, dynamic safety stock calculations, and system-driven buying signals.Technical Partnership: Act as the primary business lead, translating complex inventory and retail requirements into actionable technical specifications for Data Science and Engineering teams.Systems Design Ownership: Lead the design and configuration of all core replenishment algorithms and logic, ensuring they maximize inventory turnover and fill rates while intelligently navigating complex fashion cycles and global supply chain volatility.2. Strategic Inventory & Growth (The Business Focus)P&L Impact: Directly influence working capital performance by minimizing inventory obsolescence and maximizing product availability across our extensive network of stores and e-commerce channels.Forecasting Excellence: Implement and manage advanced models to continuously improve forecast accuracy (MAPE/WAPE) across millions of SKUs, driving significant improvements in financial planning and operational execution.Strategic Buying: Define the logic and processes for transitioning tactical purchasing to strategic oversight, ensuring system-generated buying signals and Open-to-Buy (OTB) strategies are dynamically linked to real-time sales and financial goals.3. Cross-Functional Leadership & AdoptionChange Agent: Lead the cultural and technical adoption of the new platform across the organization (Merchandising, Finance, Retail Operations). Challenge the status quo and enforce a data-driven decision-making culture.New Product Integration: Design the system capabilities to seamlessly integrate new product introductions (NPIs) and manage product lifecycle events, ensuring rapid scaling and minimal end-of-life write-offs.
The Essentials:Experience: 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in Inventory Planning, Supply Chain Systems, or Merchandise Planning, with a strong track record of defining, building, or significantly revamping a core planning platform (internal or external).Technical Acumen: Proven experience as a business lead for enterprise planning solutions, with a deep, practical understanding of time-series forecasting, statistical modeling, and machine learning applications in demand planning.Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Engineering, or a highly quantitative field.
The MindsetSystems & Product Thinking: You possess the intellectual curiosity and technical capability to define the architecture of a global retail planning system. You see planning as a product that requires continuous development and optimization.Analytical Rigor & Speed: You thrive on data complexity, transforming ambiguity into clear, scalable, and profitable solutions at the pace of a high-growth tech company.Transformational Leadership: You are a compelling communicator capable of driving strategic change, securing organizational alignment, and mentoring a team of high-performing planners and analysts.

content.description: India Full-Time Walk-ins & hiring events About this role # Marketing & Brand Lead ### Building Iconic Brands for a Global Consumer Business ## The Opportunity Lenskart is looking for an exceptional Marketing & Brand Leader to shape the identity, ambition and global growth of its expanding portfolio of consumer brands. With an established presence across multiple international markets and a growing portfolio of brands including Lenskart, Vincent Chase, AIRE and Meller, we are building the next generation of globally relevant eyewear and lifestyle brands. This is an opportunity to work closely with the Founder, CEO and global leadership team to define what our brands stand for, how they connect with consumers and where they can go next. You will own the strategic direction of brand building, from positioning, personality and storytelling to creative vision, consumer engagement and international expansion. The mandate is to create distinctive brands that resonate across cultures, build lasting consumer affinity and deliver meaningful business growth. With AI, technology and data reshaping the future of marketing, you will also bring a forward-looking approach to how we understand consumers, create content and build brands. This is an opportunity to shape a global brand portfolio, not simply manage a marketing function. ## The Core Mandate ### 1. Build Distinctive Brands - Define the positioning, personality, identity and long-term vision for each brand across the portfolio. - Create differentiated brand narratives and consumer propositions that establish a distinctive place in the market. - Build brand desirability through compelling storytelling, creative direction and cultural relevance. ### 2. Drive Global Brand Expansion - Develop strategies to take brands into new geographies and consumer markets. - Identify emerging consumer trends, market opportunities and competitive whitespace. - Build globally relevant brands while adapting their positioning to local cultures and consumer aspirations. ### 3. Lead Marketing & Consumer Engagement - Shape integrated marketing strategies across digital, social, content, campaigns, retail and partnerships. - Create distinctive consumer experiences that strengthen brand affinity and market presence. - Build meaningful collaborations and cultural associations that elevate brand relevance. ### 4. Shape the Future of Brand Building - Leverage AI, technology and data to transform consumer understanding, creative development and marketing effectiveness. - Challenge conventional approaches and bring new thinking to brand building, storytelling and consumer engagement. - Partner with product, design, merchandising and business leaders to translate brand vision into commercial outcomes. ## The Essentials - Significant experience in brand building and marketing across fashion, lifestyle, beauty, luxury, FMCG, D2C or consumer businesses. - Proven ability to define brand positioning, build distinctive identities and scale brands. - Exposure to international markets and diverse consumer segments. - Strong creative instincts, cultural understanding and commercial acumen. - Experience leading integrated marketing, digital and brand-building initiatives. - A global outlook and curiosity for AI, technology and the future of marketing. - Ability to influence senior leadership and translate vision into execution. ## The Mindset You are a brand builder with a strong instinct for creativity, consumers and culture. You know how to give a brand a distinctive identity, create an emotional connection and build its relevance across markets. You combine creative imagination with strategic and commercial thinking. You are globally minded, entrepreneurial and comfortable challenging established conventions. You are excited by the opportunity to build rather than simply manage, to experiment rather than follow playbooks and to use technology and AI to redefine how brands connect with consumers. Above all, you want to create brands that stand out, travel across borders and become part of consumers' lives. Details Job Type Full-Time Experience Category Marketing Deadline Posted yesterday

Lenskart is one of the world's fastest-growing eyewear brands 3,00+ stores and counting across India and a fast-expanding international footprint. Behind every store, every shelf, and every campaign sits a single question: what do we put in front of the customer, and why? That's the question this role owns.
The Opportunity :As the brand scales across India and into new markets, we're looking for a Category Head to own its most important asset: the product.This is a category-leadership role with real ownership. You'll decide what sells each season, how it's priced, how it's planned, and how it performs owning the category from the first sketch with the design team to the sell-through report at quarter-end. You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.
If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.
What you'll own :Category strategy & P&L. Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.Range & assortment architecture. Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.Buying & merchandise planning. Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.Pricing & margin. Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.Product lifecycle & launches. Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.Cross-functional partnership. Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.Data-led decisions. Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.Team leadership. Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.
What you bring :Deep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Experience :Bachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.
Requirements :• Bachelor's Degree• 5+ years of work experience with Category Management• 5+ years of Retail Apparel and Fashion experience• Authorized to work in Korea• 5+ years of work experience with Customer Data

experience managing omnichannel experience (voice + digital) at high volume and building/scaling teams across multiple geographiesStrong data and analytical orientation — comfortable owning metrics content.description:
Area Manager – Lenskart
3,300+ stores. Millions of eye tests every quarter. And we're only getting started. Come run a piece of it.Lenskart is India's largest eyewear company, now listed on the stock exchange, and it's growing faster than ever. We open new stores every week, take vision care into Tier 2 and Tier 3 India, and use AI to decide where the next store should open and to test eyes remotely.Every store, every home eye test and every happy customer in your area runs through you. As an Area Manager, you don't just manage a territory. You build it.
 What you'll doGrow your area like it's your own business● Own the revenue and P&L for your territory, including stores, home eye tests and everything in between● Hit and beat targets on sales, eye-test conversions, upselling, ATV and Reach-on-Time● Spot white spaces in your area and help decide where Lenskart opens nextBuild a team people want to be part of● Lead store managers, optometrists and field specialists● Coach on the floor and in the field, not from a desk● Turn new joiners into top performers and keep your best people growing with youMake customers fall in love with Lenskart● Own the full customer journey, from the first eye test to the final delivery● Turn upset customers into fans and make your area's NPS the one others benchmark againstRun a sharp, data-driven operation● Use live dashboards, location tracking and appointment systems to run your area in real time● Make sure every appointment is on time, every visit is tracked, and every customer gets the same Lenskart standard
 Why this role is different● You'll grow with the company. Lenskart plans to keep adding hundreds of stores a year, so new territories, bigger teams and bigger roles keep opening up.● There's a clear path up. Area Manager → Cluster Manager → City or Regional Head. People who perform move fast here.● The incentives are worth chasing, on top of a competitive fixed salary.● You'll work with real tech, including AI-led store planning, remote eye testing and live performance tracking. This isn't old-school retail.● Your work matters. Millions of Indians still don't have access to proper eye care, and every store you grow changes that.
 You're a fit if you● Have 3–4 years of experience in retail, field sales or service operations, including time leading teams● Love numbers and like being judged by them● Coach people instead of chasing them● Prefer being on the ground with your team over sitting in an office● Stay calm when a customer is upset and a target is due tonight
 What it takesThis is a high-ownership, on-the-ground role. Expect live location tracking, strict appointment timings and monthly revenue and KPI targets. If structure and accountability fire you up, you'll do very well here.
Interested candidates can share your updated profile to csanthosh.kumar@dealskart.in. You can also refer any of your friends who will be interested for the above mentioned position.
Regards,
SanthoshEmail: csanthosh.kumar@dealskart.in

content.description:
Senior Manager - Business Strategy & Operations
About the Company
Lenskart is Asia's largest eyewear company, serving over 40 million people across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond. What started as an online eyewear store in 2010 has grown into an omnichannel powerhouse with 3,000+ stores, the world's most automated eyewear manufacturing facility, and a mission to serve one billion eyes. "Good is not good enough" is something you'll hear often at Lenskart - we're constantly pushing ourselves to redefine how people see and experience the world.
About the RoleThis is an opportunity to work on some of the most important business challenges at one of India's fastest-growing consumer companies. As a Senior Manager – Business Strategy & Operations, you will work closely on high-impact strategic initiatives that help shape Lenskart's future. You will take ownership of key workstreams, collaborate with senior leadership, and drive execution across multiple business functions.This role is ideal for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex business problems, and are looking for a greater level of ownership and impact than a traditional strategy role.
Responsibilities
Own high-impact strategic initiatives from problem definition to execution, ensuring measurable business outcomes.Partner closely with business leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve operational challenges, and improve business performance.Drive cross-functional projects involving Sales, Retail, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Customer Experience teams.Build business cases, perform deep analytical problem-solving, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.Leverage AI extensively for research, analysis, reporting, automation, and decision-making. Develop AI-powered workflows that improve productivity and eliminate manual processes wherever possible.Build dashboards, operating mechanisms, and review frameworks to track business performance and ensure execution excellence.Get hands-on with execution by working directly with business teams, stores, vendors, and stakeholders to understand problems firsthand and implement practical solutions.Present structured recommendations and updates to senior leadership through crisp communication and data-backed insights.
Qualifications
Undergraduate degree from an IIT (or another top-tier engineering institute) and/or an MBA from an IIM or another leading global business school.2–5 years of experience in management consulting (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Kearney, Strategy&, Oliver Wyman, etc.), investment banking, founder's office, CEO's office, business strategy, business operations, or high-growth startups.Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities with experience handling complex, ambiguous business problems.Demonstrated ownership of high-impact projects with measurable business outcomes.Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets, SQL (preferred), data analysis, and business storytelling.Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, or similar) with the ability to build AI-assisted workflows, automations, or lightweight agents that improve business productivity.Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex ideas into clear recommendations.Founder, startup, or entrepreneurial experience will be considered a strong advantage.
What You Can Expect
Ownership of business-critical initiatives with visible impact on the company's growth.Direct exposure to senior leadership and opportunities to influence key strategic decisions.A fast-paced, founder-led environment where exceptional performance is recognized with accelerated growth and responsibility.The opportunity to work across multiple business functions and gain a holistic understanding of scaling a global consumer brand.A culture that values first-principles thinking, speed, ownership, and continuous learning.The chance to build meaningful solutions using AI and modern technology while solving real business problems.A role that can become a defining milestone in your career—not because of the title, but because of the scale of problems you'll solve and the impact you'll create.

About Lenskart.com
Lenskart is one of the world's fastest-growing eyewear brands 3,00+ stores and counting across India and a fast-expanding international footprint. Behind every store, every shelf, and every campaign sits a single question: what do we put in front of the customer, and why? That's the question this role owns.
The opportunity
As the brand scales across India and into new markets, we're looking for a Category Head to own its most important asset: the product.This is a category-leadership role with real ownership. You'll decide what sells each season, how it's priced, how it's planned, and how it performs owning the category from the first sketch with the design team to the sell-through report at quarter-end. You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.
If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.
What you'll ownCategory strategy & P&L. Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.Range & assortment architecture. Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.Buying & merchandise planning. Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.Pricing & margin. Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.Product lifecycle & launches. Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.Cross-functional partnership. Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.Data-led decisions. Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.Team leadership. Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.What you bringDeep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.ExperienceBachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.

Building Lenskart's Retail Talent Engine in Thailand
Lenskart is one of Asia's fastest-growing omnichannel eyewear companies, with an expanding retail presence across international markets. As we continue to strengthen our footprint in Thailand, we are looking for a hands-on, execution-driven Retail Talent Acquisition professional to build the teams that power our stores and deliver exceptional customer experiences.This role will own end-to-end retail hiring across Thailand, partnering closely with Retail Operations and HR leadership to translate business needs into effective hiring plans, build strong talent pipelines and ensure our stores are consistently staffed with the right talent.
Core Mandate:
1. End-to-End Retail HiringOwn the complete recruitment lifecycle for store and frontline positions across Thailand.Drive hiring for Store Managers, Assistant Store Managers, Optometrists, Sales Associates and other retail roles.Partner with business leaders on manpower planning, hiring priorities and timely closures.Manage sourcing, interviews, selection, offer negotiations and onboarding coordination.2. Talent Sourcing & Market IntelligenceBuild proactive talent pipelines through local job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, agencies, walk-ins and other relevant channels.Develop a strong understanding of Thailand's retail talent landscape, competitor ecosystem and talent availability.Identify and engage talent ahead of business requirements and upcoming store launches.Build a sustainable network of frontline retail talent across key locations.3. Business & Stakeholder PartnershipWork closely with Retail Operations and HR leaders to understand workforce needs and deliver hiring outcomes.Drive regular hiring reviews, provide pipeline visibility and share relevant market insights.Partner with hiring managers to refine role requirements and improve selection effectiveness.Anticipate manpower gaps and proactively address hiring challenges.4. Recruitment Excellence & GovernanceMaintain accurate recruitment data and candidate records within the ATS.Track key hiring metrics including time-to-fill, offer acceptance, source effectiveness and joining ratios.Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable Thai employment regulations.Continuously improve hiring processes, efficiency and reporting.5. Employer Branding & Candidate ExperienceRepresent Lenskart's culture and employer proposition in the Thai talent market.Deliver a responsive and engaging candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.Support local recruitment initiatives, hiring events and employer branding efforts.The EssentialsProven experience in Talent Acquisition, with strong exposure to high-volume retail or frontline hiring.Experience hiring for customer-facing roles such as Store Managers, Sales Associates, Customer Advisors and Optometrists.Strong understanding of Thailand's retail talent market, local sourcing channels and hiring practices.Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, job portals, ATS platforms and alternative sourcing channels.Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities.Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates and deliver against tight timelines.Excellent communication, negotiation and candidate engagement skills.Fluency in Thai and working proficiency in English.Self-driven, resourceful and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing business.

Ownership & Execution: Take complete ownership of hiring outcomes, from understanding the requirement to ensuring candidates join.Retail-first Thinking: Understand the realities of store operations and recognise the talent that drives customer experience and store performance.Speed with Quality: Deliver at pace without compromising on candidate quality or hiring experience.Business Partnership: Build credibility with business leaders, anticipate workforce needs and proactively solve hiring challenges.Builder's Mindset: Be resourceful, adaptable and comfortable building talent pipelines and recruitment processes as the business scales.
